notes: Waitress with 64 worker threads instead of the default 4. Chosen from 1, 4, 16 and 64 as the least CPU per request on CPython (81 µs at 64, 362 µs at 4); with 1 thread the server stalled.
details: Waitress with 64 worker threads instead of its default 4, one per connection in this load. Chosen from 1, 4, 16 and 64 as the least CPU per request on CPython: 362 µs at 4, 89 µs at 16, 81 µs at 64; with 1 thread the server stalled.
title: waitress, 64 threads
